name: The Unforgiving Spirit
original_name: บาปบรรพกาล
overview: In 1986, in a house for the newlyweds, a tragedy occurred. The bride committed suicide by jumping out of a window directly into a pond. After 30 years, Roth from the family of the deceased, arranged as a secretary to Ram, the heir to the groom's family. The girl set a goal to find out what really happened on the wedding day.
